params.body:
Reads the verdicts abovebeyond-ai/elixir#179 writes for `server`.

- Servers: the hardware line takes the `running` verdict when a machine is not running; the oversized line maps the `oversized` mark Elixir writes per machine (on an older row without verdicts, the 25 stays as fallback). One Judged line for `running` and `sizing`.
- Backups: the snapshot lines take the `backups` verdict; a Judged line names it.
- Speed: the 60 and 25 judged `cpuAvg30d`, a field the old Node scan wrote and the Laravel scan never has, so every machine read fine. The line now maps the oversized mark (background) and says the peak; tightness stays unjudged until an average is measured.
- `Servers` and `Backups` map to the `server` key in `MEASUREMENT_KEYS`, so the brief and the tasks carry the key and facet for them too.

Three tests in a new `ServersCardTest`. Suite green except the worktree-only `BuildStampTest`; PHPStan and Pint clean.
params.title: Servers, Backups and the cpu lines in Speed read Elixir's words
